root.name: Italian Game: Scotch Invitation Declined
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. d4 d6

overview: After 4.d4 Black declines to take on d4 and plays 4...d6, keeping e5 defended in a Philidor-like set-up. White chooses between the quiet 5.Nc3 (Black plays ...Be7 and castles) and 5.dxe5 dxe5 6.Qxd8+ with a queen trade, where White has a lead in space and Black holds with ...Bb4 or ...Nd7 ideas. The game is usually a slow manoeuvring fight; Black is solid but a little passive.

white_ideas.idea: Build space with Nc3, O-O and Bg5, keeping the tension on e5
Exchange on e5 and trade queens to exploit a small development lead
Prepare d5 or a central break when Black is passive

black_ideas.idea: Hold e5 with ...d6, ...Be7 and ...O-O, as in a Philidor structure
Develop ...Bg4, ...Nd7 and ...exd4 once the centre can be opened on Black's terms
Trade queens and play for a safe, equal endgame

typical_structures.structure: Philidor-like with Black pawns on d6/e5 against White pawns on d4/e4, with the centre in tension

character.notes: Black's d6/e5 shape is hard to break down and White has no direct attack; if the queens come off it is steady. Solid.

gambit.notes: Gambit declined, so no material changes hands.

soundness.notes: Sound for both; Black is a little passive.

structure.notes: Centre in tension (d4 against e5, with exchanges possible): Flexible.

approach.notes: A normal side line of the Italian; standard.

level.notes: Slow strategic play with few forced lines; Intermediate.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.dxe5 dxe5 6.Qxd8+
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. d4 d6 5. dxe5 dxe5 6. Qxd8+ Nxd8
sublines_that_differ.how: An early queen trade gives a drawish structure where White is better developed.

sublines_that_differ.name: 5.Nc3 Be7
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bc4 Nf6 4. d4 d6 5. Nc3 Be7 6. O-O O-O
sublines_that_differ.how: The quiet main set-up with tension kept on e5.

character.reason: Black's d6/e5 centre is hard to dislodge and there is no immediate attack.

structure.reason: The d4/e5 tension can be released in several ways.

approach.reason: A respectable side line of the Italian, not an off-the-wall choice.

level.reason: Not much to memorise but the Philidor-like plans take judgement.

plans.reason: White's centre gives a space edge and Black's defence is about holding e5.
